title: Applying Sentiment — Summary

edits.reason: The intro markPoint at bar15 'Full Squeeze — Target Achieved' marks the destination of the full 4/4-SA squeeze as an EVENT pin only; the target PRICE level is never drawn as a horizontal magnet. Band is ~78-122 (ltCandles(105,[{to:78},{to:122}])); 122 is the leg-2 .to that bar15 reaches, so the line sits exactly at the squeeze high. Gold = E2E/take-profit target per palette. Entry is already represented by the existing DBS markLine at 78 (the bar9 max-conviction entry lands on that level), so no separate entry line is added — that would duplicate the DBS line.

Lesson teaches 'mark the exact DBS or SSR zone where price is likely to react' then fires '2/4 SA: Half Size Entry' off it, yet the chart has NO markLines/markAreas at all. The half-size entry sits at the leg-1 .to (~83, ltCandles(100,[{to:83},{to:117}])) and is never drawn — teal DBS demand level. The bar15 'Target Hit — 2R vs 4R Size' is an event pin but the target price (~117, leg-2 .to) is undrawn. Drawing both the entry (83) and target (117) levels is what makes the R-multiple the lesson is explicitly comparing visually measurable. Both yAxis values are at the band edges (valid). Gold = TP target; teal = demand/long entry.
